skills.name: gmail_search
skills.description: Search the connected Gmail account using Gmail query syntax.

skills.name: gmail_read
skills.description: Read one Gmail message by ID.

skills.name: gmail_create_draft
skills.description: Create a Gmail draft without sending it.

skills.name: gmail_send_draft
skills.description: Send an existing Gmail draft by ID.

skills.name: gmail_list_labels
skills.description: List Gmail labels in the connected account.

skills.name: calendar_list_events
skills.description: List upcoming events from Google Calendar.

skills.name: calendar_get_event
skills.description: Read one Google Calendar event.

skills.name: calendar_create_event
skills.description: Create a Google Calendar event after the user explicitly requests it.

skills.name: calendar_list_calendars
skills.description: List connected Google Calendars.

skills.name: tasks_list_lists
skills.description: List Google Task lists.

skills.name: tasks_list_tasks
skills.description: List Google Tasks. Omit list_id to use the first available task list; call tasks_list_lists to choose another.

skills.name: tasks_create_task
skills.description: Create a Google Task in the first available list unless list_id is provided.

skills.name: tasks_complete_task
skills.description: Complete a Google Task by ID in the first available list unless list_id is provided.

skills.name: drive_search_files
skills.description: Search or list files in the connected Google Drive by name or content phrase. Omit query to list recent files. If permission is missing, call google_authorize.

skills.name: drive_get_file
skills.description: Read metadata for one Google Drive file by its ID.

skills.name: drive_read_text_file
skills.description: Read a small uploaded text, Markdown, CSV, JSON, or XML file from Drive. For native Google Docs or Sheets use their dedicated read tools.

skills.name: docs_read_document
skills.description: Read text from a Google Docs document, including its tabs and tables, by document ID.

skills.name: sheets_get_spreadsheet
skills.description: List titles and sizes of tabs in a Google Sheets spreadsheet by ID.

skills.name: sheets_read_range
skills.description: Read a bounded cell range from Google Sheets. Call sheets_get_spreadsheet first if you need a tab name. Omit cell_range for the first 25 rows and 10 columns.

cell_range.description: A1 range such as Sheet1!A1:J25, at most 100 rows and 20 columns

skills.name: google_authorize
skills.description: Open Google account OAuth authorization in the default web browser to connect or reconnect Gmail, Calendar, Tasks, and read-only Drive, Docs, and Sheets. Call when the user asks to connect or a Google read tool reports setup_required.

skills.name: google_connection_status
skills.description: Check whether Google Workspace is connected and whether Drive, Docs, and Sheets read permission is granted.
